complianceRules.title: Faculty to Student Ratio (FSR)
complianceRules.description: Statutory cadre requirement mandates maximum 20 students per qualified full-time faculty member in UG technical programs.
complianceRules.fixSuggestion: Recruit additional regular/contractual faculty members with AICTE-approved qualifications or adjust intake.

complianceRules.title: Minimum Built-Up Instructional Space
complianceRules.description: Built-up instructional area (classrooms, tutorial rooms, drawing halls) must meet or exceed 4.5 sq. meters per enrolled student.
complianceRules.fixSuggestion: Allocate additional instructional space or convert administrative overflow areas before applying for intake expansion.

complianceRules.title: Valid State Fire & Safety NOC
complianceRules.description: Institution must hold a currently valid Fire & Life Safety Certificate issued by State Fire Services or Municipal Authority.
complianceRules.fixSuggestion: Upload valid renewed Fire NOC with QR code and municipal dispatch number immediately to avoid show-cause.

complianceRules.title: Mandatory Cadre Ratio (Prof : Asso Prof : Asst Prof)
complianceRules.description: Cadre structure must adhere to 1 Professor : 2 Associate Professors : 6 Assistant Professors per department.
complianceRules.fixSuggestion: Promote eligible Associate Professors under CAS or release open recruitments for Professor posts.

complianceRules.title: Computer Lab Machine-to-Student Ratio
complianceRules.description: Institution must provide minimum 1 high-speed networked desktop terminal per 4 students with licensed/open-source software.
complianceRules.fixSuggestion: Procure additional desktop nodes and renew campus-wide software subscription agreements.

complianceRules.title: Mandatory Website Statutory Disclosure
complianceRules.description: Institutions must maintain an active, un-gated public Mandatory Disclosure page on their official website updated annually.
complianceRules.fixSuggestion: Update and verify hyperlinked Mandatory Disclosure document on institute homepage.

complianceRules.title: Barrier-Free Campus & Divyangjan Facilities
complianceRules.description: Wheelchair ramps, tactile paving, Braille lift signage, and designated accessible washrooms are statutory mandates.
complianceRules.fixSuggestion: Complete elevator ramp retrofit and upload physical geotagged photographs in the inspection module.

complianceRules.title: National Digital Library (NDLI) Club & E-Journals
complianceRules.description: Minimum subscription to IEEE/ASME/Springer e-journal packages and active NDLI institutional club registration.
complianceRules.fixSuggestion: Renew consortia e-journal package via DELNET/INFLIBNET and sync subscription invoice.
